title: Other EGapple particle
description: Distinguishes the Egapple particle from gapple.
body:
![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d02f883fa49100042f90f05724dae5edbf4d40bf.png)

[![discord-singular](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/social/discord-singular_vector.svg)](https://dsc.gg/spectrr3)
[![modrinth-gallery](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/documentation/modrinth-gallery_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/other-egapple-particle/gallery)

It distinguishes the apple particle from the gapple particle, and opponents often turn away when they eat gapple, but now you can tell whether they are eating gapple or gapple.
### Information:
Pack version 1.15-26.1 Snaphsot 10 (but in version lower 1.20 resource pack it will be displayed as "Made for an oder version of Minecraft", I am aware of this, but I can't do anything.)  
Removes ONLY block textures; items remain displayed as before.  
Don't forget that even if the texture is removed, you still can't hit through plants that are 2 blocks tall.
